full_judgment: 2. The plaintiff opposite party No. 1 brought the said suit for partition in respect of lands appertaining to CS Khatian No.156 claiming 3.11-1/2 acres thereto. The plaint ease is that the lands of the said CS Khatian originally belonged to Shukai Mai and Mayan Mai in equal shares. Shukai Mai sold her entire share to Kudratullah by a deed of sale dated 29.10.1919. Kudratullah died unmarried leaving his father Kasimullah as his heir. Kasimullah sold his entire share to Maijan Mai by a registered deed of sale dated 29.11.1928 and from Maijan Mai the plaintiffs purchased the entire share by registered deed of sale dated 20.3.1936. Thus the plaintiff became the owner and possessor of 3.78-1/2 acres of land. Subsequently the plaintiffs sold away 0.30 acre and gifted 0.37 acre respectively to defendant Nos. 3 and 4. Thus the plaintiff is at present owning and possessing 3.11-1/2 acres of land from the suit jote.
